items.name: Cube Against Cancer - Orange County 2026
items.information:
**This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerOC2026#72568-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information.**

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerOC2026#69913-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating (We ask that each competitor bring no more than 2 guests). 

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/), [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/), and the [Aliso Niguel Cubing Club](https://alisoniguel.capousd.org/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyMDQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e340c5f76c042e96f0777c1dbdb76f87416ee1f9/Cube%20Against%20Cancer%20-%20Orange%20County%202025%20(1).png)

items.name: Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026

venue.name: Greenwoods Area 4 - Covered Court
venue.details: The venue is between Gardenia Street and Jasmine Street

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcwNDE4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--95d7a7dbf2c712d3c9ec52b7f2822d1e6ddbd303/Greenwoods%20Summer%20Overtime%202026.png)

Welcome to **Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026**.

This competition serves as the sequel to **[Greenwoods Clock Clash 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsClockClash2026)** and will feature **Clock** as the main event. Additional official events include **3×3, Megaminx, Skewb, 3x3 One-Handed (OH), 3x3 Fewest Moves (FMC), and 5×5 Blindfolded (5BLD)**.

The competition will also include the unofficial event **3×3 Team Blindfolded**. Participation in unofficial events is entirely optional and will not affect official competition results. Additional unofficial events, including **1×3×3 Floppy Cube** and **Magic**, are **tentative** and may be added depending on schedule availability and logistical considerations. Please refer to the **[Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsSummerOvertime2026#72726-unofficial-events-info-registration)** tab for further details.

All competitors and guests are encouraged to carefully review the information tabs on this page for details regarding the **competition schedule, event regulations, venue guidelines, and registration procedures**. Familiarizing yourself with this information will help ensure the competition runs smoothly and that all participants have an enjoyable experience.

We look forward to seeing you at **Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026**.

items.name: Happy Valley Spring PA 2026

venue.name: [HUB-Robeson Center](https://studentaffairs.psu.edu/hub)
venue.details: Heritage Hall, first floor of the HUB

items.information:
## PSU students must leave their PSU email as a comment on their registration to qualify for the discounted registration fee of $10. The full registration fee ($25) must be paid, and then qualifying registrations will receive the refund.

## Competitors may bring at most one guest. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.

## In accordance with University policy all competitors 17 years of age and younger MUST have their legal guardian accompanying them to this competition.

## All proceeds from the event will be going to the PSU Rubik's Cube Club.

* Competitors may bring at most one guest.
* Heritage Hall is located on the first floor of the HUB. To easily get to Heritage Hall inside the HUB-Robeson Center, you may take any of the elevators on the food court level up to the first floor **except for the elevator next to the Panda Express/Sbarro shops**. From there, Heritage Hall should be just within range to your left or right.
* The organizing team strongly recommends receiving a COVID-19 vaccination before competing. For information on, and finding vaccines near you, please use [this website](https://www.vaccines.gov/)!
* If you have symptoms related to COVID-19 such as cough, fever, shortness of breath, etc. do not attend this competition.
* If you have had a positive COVID-19 test or prolonged exposure to someone with the virus within 14 days prior to the competition, do not attend.
* By registering for this competition, you agree that you understand all the information presented in this tab, will abide by all the COVID-19 restrictions placed on this competition, and acknowledge the risk of contracting COVID-19 or any other disease in attending an event of this scale.

items.name: Hungarian All-Rounder 3 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcW9sIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8de80ca5b65533e48bb2a5f8df2ce87a38508762/HU.png)
​
A Hungarian All-Rounder 2026 egy 10 állomásból álló versenysorozat, melyen (a WCA-helyezéseken felül) a versenyzők összesített eredményeit is díjazzuk.

A versenyzőknek azokon a versenyszámokon is jelen kell lenniük, amikben nem versenyeznek, mert azokban a versenyszámokban is be lesznek osztva bíráskodni, amikre nem regisztráltak. A bíráskodás elmulasztása a versenyről való kizárással járhat. 
***
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcWtsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a418957a26bf064989b7de2ff14f6260f20fa9c3/UK.png)
​
Hungarian All-Rounder 2026 is a series inculding 10 competitions, after which prizes will be awarded based on the aggregate results of competitors (beside WCA podiums).

To participate in the competition you must be present at every event, even if you are not registered to all of them. If you fail to be present when you are scheduled to judge, you can be disqualified from the competition.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYzOTg5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a659b4b3a0846bfe61508b639b1f1ee6ccc8206f/image.png)
MindCube Open Tegucigalpa 2026 será el tercer torneo oficial del año en el país, consolidando el crecimiento del speedcubing a nivel nacional. Se otorgarán premios a los primeros lugares de cada categoría y será un evento abierto a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, promoviendo la sana competencia y el desarrollo de nuevos talentos.
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
MindCube Open Tegucigalpa 2026 will be the third official tournament of the year in the country, further strengthening the growth of speedcubing at the national level. Awards will be given to the top finishers in each event, and the competition will be open to participants of all nationalities, promoting fair play and the development of new talent.
